name: Drávacsehi (Hungary)
description: Green field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Drávacsehi (a shield with a yellow chevron dividing blue from green, with two yellow acorn boughs) below the name DRÁVACSEHI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
